meta.title: Leadership — Members
meta.description: How members build leadership skills through meeting roles, officer positions, and Toastmasters' leadership pathways.

page_hero.headline: Leadership is a practised craft.
page_hero.intro: Members grow into leadership through meeting roles, club officer positions, and the leadership tracks in Pathways.

unique_approach.body: Our club has a unique approach to leadership development. To learn more, please email us.

sections.heading: Every meeting is member-run
sections.body: Chair the meeting, run Table Topics, evaluate a speech, keep time, or track filler words. Each role is a small, structured leadership rep — you get one every Wednesday.

more_items.name: Toastmaster of the Day
more_items.body: Chairs the whole meeting — introduces the theme, cues each role, keeps energy and pacing.

more_items.name: General Evaluator
more_items.body: Runs the evaluation portion and gives the meeting itself a report card.

more_items.name: Speech Evaluator
more_items.body: Delivers a 2–3 minute evaluation of one prepared speech against the Pathways project criteria.

more_items.name: Topicsmaster
more_items.body: Runs the Table Topics session — writes questions, reads the room, and calls speakers.

more_items.name: Timer
more_items.body: Signals each speaker on time and reports the numbers.

more_items.name: Ah-Counter
more_items.body: Tracks filler words and reports back so speakers can hear their own habits.

more_items.name: Grammarian / Wordmaster
more_items.body: Picks a Word of the Day, notes language use, gives a report at the end.

sections.heading: Take on a club officer role
sections.body: Elected officer terms are six months. Each role runs a piece of the club and represents real project-management practice — with a supportive board around you.

more_items.name: President
more_items.body: Leads the club, chairs the executive committee, sets the year's direction.

more_items.name: VP Education
more_items.body: Programs the year — assigns Pathways mentors, schedules speeches, tracks progress.

more_items.name: VP Membership
more_items.body: Recruits guests, onboards new members, handles retention.

more_items.name: VP Public Relations
more_items.body: Marketing, social, external comms — the club's voice to the world.

more_items.name: Secretary
more_items.body: Keeps meeting minutes, member records, and club correspondence.

more_items.name: Treasurer
more_items.body: Runs dues, budget, and the annual filings.

more_items.name: Sergeant-at-Arms
more_items.body: Sets up the room, brings the banner and timer, greets guests.

sections.heading: Structured leadership tracks
sections.body: Several of the current Pathways paths focus directly on leadership — from running teams to setting long-range direction. Each path has five levels and its own rubric, so leadership becomes a set of practised, evaluated projects rather than an abstract idea.

more_items.name: Dynamic Leadership
more_items.body: Leadership and communication styles, conflict management, organisational change, and public speaking applied to leadership.

more_items.name: Persuasive Influence
more_items.body: Negotiation, interpersonal communication, and leadership through complex situations.

more_items.name: Motivational Strategies
more_items.body: Building connections, understanding motivation, and leading small groups — culminates in a team-building project.

more_items.name: Visionary Communication
more_items.body: Strategic communication, speech writing and delivery, and developing a long-term personal or professional vision.
